text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of a trial race workshop, 
inviting young Umamusume from outside the 
academy to participate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the academy, Nishino Flower and 
Sakura Bakushin O joined as helpers, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Flower-san! Let's do our best together 
today! Come now, there's nothing at all to 
worry about!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With me around, the trial lesson is 
guaranteed to be a roaring success! Their 
growth will also be a major Bakushin 
certainty! Put your trust in me, and let's 
forge ahead!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes. I'll do my very best so I can act 
like a role-model big sister...!"

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
The children will be arriving shortly, so 
please get everything ready!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the trial class began, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words! To Bakushin even further, 
it is necessary to move both legs in an 
even more Bakushin-like manner—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't really understand what you're 
saying, Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaah!? My apologies! It seems I 
bakushin'd through my explanation a bit 
too quickly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words! Moving both legs with 
Bakushin power means infusing every single 
step with Bakushin—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I-It hasn't really changed at allll...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, this is where we do uphill slope 
training—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
—That person isn't much taller than us, 
huh. I wonder if she's close to our age?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Maybe my legs are faster? Just kidding~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Taking a break, I asked Nishino Flower 
and the others about the children's 
reactions, but things didn't seem to be 
going very well...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It appears my Bakushin enthusiasm was 
simply too overwhelming for you! Ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
As for me, people don't really listen to 
what I have to say... What should I do...?
choice_data_list:
Let's show them what training together at 
full strength looks like.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! You mean we should convey 
Flower-san's and my Bakushin-esque passion 
with even greater fervor through an 
all-out Bakushin?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-Will it go well, I wonder?
choice_data_list:
Let's show them what a big sister can 
really do!

Let's show them what a big sister can 
really do!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood, I'll give it a try! 
Bakushin O-san, I'm in your care!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
A-Amaaazing! It's just like a real 
race...! So that's what Bakushin means...!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"She's so small, but so amazing...! I 
could never run that fast...!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I'm sure all of you will be able 
to run even faster, too.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Really!? I want to try running like you 
too, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The passion of Nishino Flower and the 
others came through in their running, 
making the mock race workshop a truly 
memorable experience for the children—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! By combining our Bakushin-esque 
passion, we will bakushin even deeper into 
everyone's hearts!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... will everyone actually listen to 
what I have to say...?
choice_data_list: Let's have Bakushin O cover for that part.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Leave it to me! I shall take the 
vanguard and draw everyone's attention! 
Then, they will surely listen to what we 
have to say!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
U-Understood! I'll believe in Trainer and 
Bakushin O-san, and give it everything 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—In other words! To achieve the ultimate 
Bakushin, one must prepare for the 
Bakushin, and unleash a Bakushin-level 
acceleration when the moment strikes!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, it takes a little time to accelerate 
to top speed, so—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"So to hit top speed at the critical 
moment, I need to time my acceleration 
just right, is that it?!"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if it's that, then maybe I kind of get 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! An exemplary Bakushin-style 
supplement! As expected of you, 
Flower-san! That made it so much easier to 
understand!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, she's almost like a teacher... 
Even though she's tiny, she really is a 
big sister...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed! Flower-san is an exemplary 
and extremely studious person!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: T-That's not—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By joining forces, Nishino Flower and the 
others were able to turn the workshop into 
a memorable experience for the children—
